lines.zh: 铁靴踩着泥，一步一步往你这边来。
lines.en: Iron boots press the mud, one step nearer to you.

lines.zh: 我的剑口卷了，走路时还在响。
lines.en: My blade is notched, and it still rings as I walk.

lines.zh: 铠甲缝里漏出绿水，滴在草上。
lines.en: Green water leaks from my armor seams onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我从不下水，只在陆地上行军。
lines.en: I never enter water; I march only on dry land.

lines.zh: 生前我走这条道，死后还走。
lines.en: I walked this road alive, and walk it dead.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个听见我脚步的人。
lines.en: You are not the first to hear my footsteps.

lines.zh: 盾牌挂在左臂，磨得发亮。
lines.en: The shield on my left arm is worn smooth and bright.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可从不改方向。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never change direction.

lines.zh: 夜里风大，我的盔缨还在抖。
lines.en: The night wind is strong; my helmet plume still shakes.

lines.zh: 两具铁甲一同走过麦田。
lines.en: Two suits of iron cross the wheat field together.

lines.zh: 我踩断枯枝，也不低头看。
lines.en: I snap dead branches and never look down.

lines.zh: 泥里的脚印比活人的深。
lines.en: My prints in the mud sink deeper than a living man's.

lines.zh: 我绕开水面，水会烂我的甲。
lines.en: I skirt the water; it would rot my armor.

lines.zh: 这条土路，我认得每一块石头。
lines.en: On this dirt road I know every stone.

lines.zh: 我的护胫上还挂着去年的泥。
lines.en: Last year's mud still clings to my greaves.

lines.zh: 同伴落下一步，我不等它。
lines.en: My comrade falls a step behind. I don't wait.

lines.zh: 我站着，铁甲里没有呼吸声。
lines.en: I stand still, and no breath sounds inside the iron.

lines.zh: 风吹过空头盔，发出一点呜声。
lines.en: Wind crosses the empty helm and makes a low moan.

lines.zh: 我在等命令，可没人再下令。
lines.en: I wait for orders, but no one gives them now.

lines.zh: 剑尖抵着地，我数自己的骨节。
lines.en: Sword tip on the ground, I count my own joints.

lines.zh: 铠甲生锈了，我懒得擦。
lines.en: The armor has rusted, and I cannot be bothered to wipe it.

lines.zh: 太阳晒我，我也不觉得暖。
lines.en: The sun falls on me, and I feel no warmth.

lines.zh: 我低头看胸口的破洞。
lines.en: I look down at the hole in my breastplate.

lines.zh: 坟土的味道，我早就习惯了。
lines.en: The smell of grave soil is long familiar.

lines.zh: 有一瞬间，我忘了自己在哪。
lines.en: For a moment I forget where I stand.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的钟，却没去。
lines.en: I hear a distant bell and do not go.

lines.zh: 铁手套握紧，又慢慢松开。
lines.en: My gauntlet tightens, then slowly opens.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是还想挥剑。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to swing a sword.

lines.zh: 夜里我站得比树还稳。
lines.en: At night I stand steadier than the trees.

lines.zh: 风把我的披风扯成两条。
lines.en: The wind tears my cloak into two strips.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，先量你的脖子。
lines.en: I raise my eyes and measure your neck first.

lines.zh: 你的护甲比我新，我记住了。
lines.en: Your armor is newer than mine, and I note it.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛会躲，你不躲。
lines.en: Living eyes look away; yours do not.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里有剑。
lines.en: I stare at your hand, where the sword is.

lines.zh: 海边的风，把血腥味送来。
lines.en: The sea wind carries the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我歪头，盔里的骨头咔了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head; a bone clicks inside the helm.

lines.zh: 你比上一个高半头，也一样。
lines.en: You stand half a head taller, and just the same.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块待劈的木头。
lines.en: I look at you like wood waiting to be split.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太吵，我听见了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我把剑换到右手，你该懂了。
lines.en: I shift my sword to the right hand; you understand.

lines.zh: 剑砍进甲缝，我闷哼了一声。
lines.en: The blade bites my armor seam, and I grunt once.

lines.zh: 岸上比海里更难受。
lines.en: Dry land hurts more than the sea.

lines.zh: 伤口没有血，只掉下一点锈。
lines.en: The wound bleeds nothing, only sheds a little rust.

lines.zh: 这点痛，比死那回轻多了。
lines.en: This pain is lighter than dying was.

lines.zh: 我的护腕裂了，我记住了这笔。
lines.en: My bracer cracks, and I mark the debt.

lines.zh: 你的刀很快，可我不怕第二次。
lines.en: Your blade is quick, and I do not fear a second cut.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，像看旧账。
lines.en: I look at the wound as at an old account.

lines.zh: 骨头断了，我就用另一只手。
lines.en: The bone breaks, so I use the other hand.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起自己还站着。
lines.en: The pain reminds me I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我被打得偏了头，又转回来。
lines.en: The hit turns my head aside, and I turn it back.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我只看你的手腕。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I watch your wrist instead.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想让你靠近些。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only want you closer.

lines.zh: 腐肉对我没用，我早就不饿了。
lines.en: Rotten flesh is useless to me; I stopped being hungry.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，退了三步，聪明。
lines.en: You set the food down and step back three paces, wise.

lines.zh: 我伸手，是去够你的剑，不是饼。
lines.en: My hand reaches for your sword, not the bread.

lines.zh: 别喂我，喂我的人都没回来。
lines.en: Do not feed me; none who fed me came back.

lines.zh: 那点麦香，让我想起生前的灶。
lines.en: That smell of wheat recalls the hearth I had alive.

lines.zh: 我闻到熟肉，盔里闷闷一响。
lines.en: I smell cooked meat, and something knocks inside my helm.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，换不来我的停步。
lines.en: What you hold cannot buy my halt.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，又抬头看你。
lines.en: I lower my head to sniff, then look up at you.

lines.zh: 铁甲撞上来，像一堵会走的墙。
lines.en: The iron hits like a wall that learned to walk.

lines.zh: 你撞我，肩甲上的锈掉了一层。
lines.en: You strike me and rust flakes off my pauldron.

lines.zh: 我肩甲一顶，你连退三步。
lines.en: One shove of my pauldron sends you back three steps.

lines.zh: 骨头在甲里响，我却没让路。
lines.en: Bones rattle in the plate, and I still do not yield.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我的剑抬起来了。
lines.en: You come too close, and my sword rises.

lines.zh: 我的甲冰冷，你的手缩回去了。
lines.en: My armor is cold, and your hand pulls back.

lines.zh: 碰撞声惊起了田里的乌鸦。
lines.en: The clash startles crows out of the field.

lines.zh: 我侧身，让你从盾牌边挤过。
lines.en: I turn so you can squeeze past my shield.

lines.zh: 你撞开我的护肩，露出发黑的骨头。
lines.en: You knock my pauldron loose, baring blackened bone.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没说话。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，两副空盔甲。
lines.en: We stand side by side, two empty suits of armor.

lines.zh: 同袍之间不必说话，只需同向。
lines.en: Comrades need no words, only the same direction.

lines.zh: 我和它一起守这条无人的路。
lines.en: It and I keep this empty road together.

lines.zh: 两柄卷刃剑在夜里轻轻相碰。
lines.en: Two notched swords touch softly in the dark.

lines.zh: 我们不会生育，只会一起站岗。
lines.en: We do not breed; we only stand watch together.

lines.zh: 它替我挡箭，我替它挥剑。
lines.en: It takes arrows for me; I swing for it.

lines.zh: 队伍只剩我们两个，也还是队伍。
lines.en: Only two of us remain, and we are still a company.

lines.zh: 我把盾牌挪过去，遮住它的侧身。
lines.en: I shift my shield to cover its flank.

lines.zh: 我们在坟前并排跪下，又站起。
lines.en: We kneel together at the grave, then rise.

lines.zh: 死人之间也有约定，比活人久。
lines.en: The dead keep promises longer than the living.

lines.zh: 我弯腰拾起掉落的铁片。
lines.en: I bend and pick up the fallen iron scrap.

lines.zh: 地上有把断剑，我捡起来掂了掂。
lines.en: A broken sword lies there; I weigh it in my hand.

lines.zh: 我不捡钱，只捡能砍的东西。
lines.en: I collect no coins, only things that can cut.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我替你踢到一边。
lines.en: You dropped something; I kick it aside for you.

lines.zh: 我戴上那顶破头盔，正合适。
lines.en: I put on that cracked helm, and it fits.

lines.zh: 拾起骨头，我把它塞回甲缝。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and wedge it back into the plate.

lines.zh: 这枚铁钉，能补我的护腕。
lines.en: This iron nail will patch my bracer.

lines.zh: 我把战利品堆在脚边，没数。
lines.en: I pile the spoils at my feet and do not count.

lines.zh: 我不需要钥匙，门我会砸开。
lines.en: I need no key; I will break the door.

lines.zh: 捡起盾牌时，我的指骨响了一声。
lines.en: As I lift the shield, a finger bone clicks.

lines.zh: 你踏进这片草地，我就选了你。
lines.en: You step into this grass, and I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 甲片擦响，我的目标只有你。
lines.en: My plates rasp; you are my only target.

lines.zh: 我抬起剑，盔里的眼睛亮了。
lines.en: I raise my sword, and the eyes in my helm light up.

lines.zh: 你离得最近，所以先是你。
lines.en: You are closest, so you are first.

lines.zh: 我闻见活气，脚步立刻改了向。
lines.en: I catch living breath and my stride turns at once.

lines.zh: 这一带归我守，你来错地方了。
lines.en: I keep this ground; you came to the wrong place.

lines.zh: 我的剑指向你，不必再问。
lines.en: My sword points at you; no more questions.

lines.zh: 你回头看我，我就当你应战。
lines.en: You look back, and I take it as acceptance.

lines.zh: 猎物会喘气，你不会例外。
lines.en: Prey breathes, and you are no exception.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的脸，虽然我看不清。
lines.en: I memorize your face, though I barely see it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕过石墙，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow you around the stone wall, never a step behind.

lines.zh: 你跑进树林，铁甲声还在你身后。
lines.en: You run into the trees; iron still sounds behind you.

lines.zh: 我不急，我的腿比你耐走。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; my legs outlast yours.

lines.zh: 你翻过栅栏，我直接把栅栏撞断。
lines.en: You climb the fence; I simply break through it.

lines.zh: 别爬高，我不会抬头看太久。
lines.en: Do not climb high; I will not look up for long.

lines.zh: 你在河里以为安全，我在岸上等。
lines.en: You think the river is safe; I wait on the bank.

lines.zh: 我始终隔三步，剑尖对着你。
lines.en: I keep three paces off, sword point on you.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的靴子也换了方向。
lines.en: You change direction, and my boots change with you.

lines.zh: 追人这件事，我做过很多回。
lines.en: Chasing people is work I have done many times.

lines.zh: 你听见的铁响，是我在加速。
lines.en: The iron you hear is me picking up speed.

lines.zh: 剑落下来，带着一百年的力气。
lines.en: The sword falls with a hundred years behind it.

lines.zh: 我劈你的肩，甲片飞了出去。
lines.en: I chop your shoulder, and a plate flies off.

lines.zh: 这一下不是为了杀，是为了记住。
lines.en: This blow is not to kill, but to remember.

lines.zh: 剑背砸在你胸口，你退了半步。
lines.en: The flat of my blade hits your chest; you stagger back.

lines.zh: 我的剑不快，可它从不落空。
lines.en: My sword is slow, but it never misses.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，虎口却裂开了。
lines.en: You block it, and your palm splits open.

lines.zh: 我用盾撞你，再用剑跟上。
lines.en: I slam you with the shield and follow with the sword.

lines.zh: 铁器相击，火星落进草里。
lines.en: Steel meets steel, and sparks drop into the grass.

lines.zh: 我砍下去时，盔里发出一声低吼。
lines.en: As I cut, a low growl comes from my helm.

lines.zh: 剑砍进去，我只听见骨响。
lines.en: The blade goes in; I only hear bone.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起，先扶正头盔。
lines.en: I rise from the soil and straighten my helm first.

lines.zh: 夜里这片陆地把我推了出来。
lines.en: The night pushes me up onto this land.

lines.zh: 甲片一层层扣上，我才睁眼。
lines.en: Plate locks over plate before I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从不出现在海上，那里没有我。
lines.en: I never appear at sea; there is nothing of me there.

lines.zh: 这次来了两个，我们并排走。
lines.en: Two of us came this time, and we walk abreast.

lines.zh: 我捡起插在坟头的旧剑。
lines.en: I pull the old sword from the grave mound.

lines.zh: 泥土从我肩上落下，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Soil slides off my shoulders, and I shake it away.

lines.zh: 主世界的风吹干了我身上的土层。
lines.en: Overworld wind dries the earth on my body.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就知道该往哪走。
lines.en: The moment I open my eyes, I know which way to go.

lines.zh: 这块地安静太久，该有铁声了。
lines.en: This ground has been quiet too long; it needs iron.

lines.zh: 火烧我的甲，皮肉在里面焦了。
lines.en: Fire heats my armor and chars the flesh inside.

lines.zh: 落地时，我的膝盖骨错开了。
lines.en: On landing, my kneecap slips out of place.

lines.zh: 水灌进头盔，我不需要呼吸，只是沉。
lines.en: Water fills my helm; I do not breathe, I only sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞了我的盾，我爬起来找。
lines.en: The blast throws my shield away; I rise and look for it.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在胸甲上，我拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my breastplate, and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 药水烧我的骨头，冒出绿烟。
lines.en: The potion burns my bones and rises as green smoke.

lines.zh: 我不会饿死，只会越来越慢。
lines.en: I cannot starve to death; I only slow down.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我剑上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my sword, and I twitch once.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我落不到底。
lines.en: The void has no soil, and I never land.
